remarks: Elevated Thousand Oaks living with a view to match. Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, 1390 Oakridge Court offers 3,026 square feet of beautifully appointed living space with four bedrooms, three bathrooms and an oversized bonus room. Soaring ceilings, abundant natural light and generous living spaces create an open and inviting feel throughout. At the heart of the home is the stunning kitchen, completely remodeled in 2023 with no expense spared, featuring custom cabinetry, expansive countertops, an oversized center island, stainless steel appliances and exceptional storage. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the family room, creating an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining
